speaker: consultant
text: Good morning, Elena Ward speaking.

speaker: customer
text: Hi Elena, this is Tom Becker. We had a discovery call last week about my accounting practice.

speaker: consultant
text: Yes, of course, Tom. Good to hear from you again.

speaker: customer
text: I have been thinking about it, and I am stuck between the Growth Package and the monthly retainer.

speaker: consultant
text: That is a common question. Let me explain the difference. The Growth Package is six sessions over three months for nine hundred and fifty dollars. It is best for one clear project with a start and an end.

speaker: customer
text: And the retainer?

speaker: consultant
text: The retainer is six hundred dollars per month, with two sessions a month and email support. I reply to emails within one business day. It works better when you want ongoing support while you make many decisions.

speaker: customer
text: The retainer has a minimum, right?

speaker: consultant
text: Yes, the minimum is three months. After that you can cancel with thirty days notice.

speaker: customer
text: So three months of retainer is eighteen hundred dollars, compared to nine fifty for the package.

speaker: consultant
text: Correct. You get twice as many sessions with the retainer, plus the email support.

speaker: customer
text: My main goal is to hire two new staff and change how we price our services. Is that one project or two?

speaker: consultant
text: Honestly, it could be either. If you want to move fast on both at the same time, the retainer gives you more contact. If you are happy to do pricing first and hiring later, the package is enough.

speaker: customer
text: Hmm. I need to talk to my wife about the budget. She manages our finances.

speaker: consultant
text: That makes sense. Would it help if I sent you a short comparison by email, so you can look at it together?

speaker: customer
text: Yes, that would help a lot.

speaker: consultant
text: I will send it today. There is no pressure, take the time you need.

speaker: customer
text: Thanks. I will probably get back to you by the end of next week.

speaker: consultant
text: Sounds good, Tom. Feel free to email me if any questions come up before then.

speaker: customer
text: Will do. Thanks, Elena.
